critic.reading: the size of the space bears on search only if the landscape is rugged (M-407, M-404)
critic.number: none: the critic position concedes the arithmetic and disputes its relevance; the search count under cumulative selection is M-407

notes: 20^250 = 1.809e325 (10^325.257) reproduces Eden's 'about 10^325'. The working paper's 10^350 for 'length 250 or less' does not reproduce: all lengths up to 250 give 20/19 x 20^250 = 10^325.28, 24.7 orders below the printed figure. Against any of the molecule counts in the corpus (10^40 to 10^55.02) the explored fraction is 10^-270 to 10^-285, so the 273-order comparison does not depend on which count is used. The arithmetic is not in dispute between the sides; its bearing on search is (M-407).
